evidence_boundary: Nodes and edges are grounded in the retrieved 166-page PDF by section, page, and theorem/proposition references. This is a dependency graph of the paper's stated construction, not an independent mathematical audit.

nodes.name: Leading-order flow and annular stress
nodes.internal_construction: Construct E,U,Π and derive V0 from incompressibility and pressure balance; integrate tangential residual radially.
nodes.exported_object: (u^(0), p^(0), T0), five cumulative radial integrals, exact heat exterior, admissible stress-cone condition

nodes.name: All-order base correction
nodes.internal_construction: Solve coefficient equations near the axis, extend radially, impose moment conditions, and sum via vector-potential/pressure cutoffs.
nodes.exported_object: (uB,pB), physical annular stress Tphys, flat remainder EB
nodes.validation_condition: Proposition 5.5 verifies incompressibility, support, exterior preservation, and flat residual remainder.

nodes.name: Auxiliary torus and support separation
assumptions: background and annular stress from Proposition 5.5
nodes.internal_construction: Build the phase-evaluation map, dyadic charts, slow cutoffs, and disjoint auxiliary rectangles for overlapping supports.
nodes.exported_object: Y evaluation map, normalized derivative operators, partitions, label supports Kγ, cross-term separation rule
nodes.validation_condition: Lemma 6.1, Lemma 6.2, and Proposition 6.6 provide separation and derivative/product bounds.

nodes.name: Oscillatory realization of residual stress
nodes.internal_construction: Construct phases and amplitude equations for two wave families; choose positive squared amplitudes; evaluate curls of supported vector potentials.
nodes.exported_object: divergence-free wave field w and averaged covariance ⟨w_r(w_θ,w_z)⟩ = T0 + higher-order terms
nodes.validation_condition: Proposition 7.5 matches the stress; Lemma 7.7 gives exact incompressibility; Corollary 7.8 bounds covariance remainders.

nodes.name: Compactly supported mean corrections
assumptions: actual divergence-free wave covariance including curl remainders
zero weighted radial moments for compact inverses
nodes.internal_construction: Invert radial and auxiliary-time operators; reconstruct pressure and divergence-free corrections; solve five moment equations.
nodes.exported_object: compactly supported mean velocity/pressure corrections and defects P,Jθ,Jz reduced while preserving Mθ,Mz

nodes.name: Residual improvement and local field
assumptions: fixed background, wave, support, and inverse operators
nodes.internal_construction: Recompute the full residual, run the four-operation correction cycle, and sum corrections with shrinking cutoffs.
nodes.exported_object: local fields (uloc,ploc), residual flat to every order near q=0, preserved growth and support bounds
nodes.validation_condition: Proposition 9.6 and Proposition 9.9; Theorem 3.1 gives derivative flatness.

nodes.name: Compact forcing and whole-space breakdown
assumptions: smooth cutoffs equal to one near (0,1)
nodes.internal_construction: Localize vector potentials, azimuthal field, and pressure; take curl after cutoff; set f=R(u,p); extend smoothly through t=1.
nodes.exported_object: smooth compactly supported force f, global localized solution, bounded L2 energy and unbounded Linfinity velocity
